description: This file defines the implementation dependencies, classes, and methods for the Open Fronthaul receiver in the ocudu namespace, including receiver dependencies, dispatcher, and main receiver class.

classes.name: receiver_impl_dependencies
classes.description: Holds dependencies required by the receiver implementation, including message receiver dependencies, window handler dependencies, symbol reorderer, and Ethernet receiver.

classes.name: ota_symbol_boundary_dispatcher
classes.description: Dispatches OTA symbol boundary notifications to registered handlers.

classes.name: receiver_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the receiver, managing dependencies, and coordinating various components such as message receiver, symbol reorderer, and controller.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles new symbol notifications and dispatches to registered handlers.

methods.name: receiver_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: get_ota_symbol_boundary_notifier
methods.description: Returns the OTA symbol boundary notifier.
